title: Charge-to-mass ratio
description: Essential: The final answer for part (1) must be correctly derived and expressed as q/m = 2U/(B²R²).

title: Work-energy theorem application
description: Important: The solution must relate the electric potential energy qU to the kinetic energy (1/2)mv² to find the particle's speed.

title: Lorentz force as centripetal
description: Important: The solution must apply qvB = mv²/r to relate speed, magnetic field, and radius of curvature in the magnetic field region.

title: Geometry for exit length
description: Important: For part (2), the solution must correctly use geometry (Pythagorean theorem) to find the maximum left and right exit points on y=2R.

title: Angle and time relation
description: Important: For part (3), the solution must correctly calculate the central angle of motion in the magnetic field and relate it to the period T = 2πm/(qB).

title: Final exit length
description: Essential: The final answer for part (2) must be correctly expressed as (1 + √(2√2 - 1))R.

title: Final magnetic field time
description: Essential: The final answer for part (3) must be correctly expressed as πBR²/(24U).

title: Sign or unit error
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the charge-to-mass ratio has an incorrect sign, or if answers lack proper units or dimensional consistency.

title: Geometry misinterpretation
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the angles of rotation (e.g., 75°, 15°, 60°) or the geometry of the circular arc and boundaries are incorrectly identified.

title: Period formula misuse
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the period T = 2πm/(qB) is incorrectly stated or misapplied when calculating the time in the magnetic field.
